Cookie Policy
Updated April 2022
1. FOREWORD

Pursuant to Article 13 of Regulation EU 679/2016 on personal data protection (hereinafter, the “Regulation” or “GDPR”), Luigi Lavazza S.p.A., in its capacity as personal data Controller, wishes to inform you that this website uses “cookies” and similar technologies in order to improve your experience on its websites (including mobile versions) and Apps and to recognize you during your next visit. Cookies and similar technologies can perform certain functions and personalise content. We ask you to read this Cookie Policy where we provide all the information concerning the use of such technologies.
2. WHAT ARE COOKIES?

Cookies are short strings of text that are automatically downloaded onto the user’s browser or other device, with its consent (where required) when browsing our websites (including mobile versions) or when using our apps. This allows us, on each next visit to keep track of each user’s choices and thus offer a more efficient and customized experience.

Some cookies collect information to protect our website, other cookies provide information to help us improve its performance while others are used to customise content. Every cookie performs a specific action and based on the function and purpose of use they can be divided into technical, aggregate analysis, and profiling cookies.

As you navigate this Website, you can either install “first party” or “third party” cookies. The term “first party cookies” means cookies that are installed and managed personally by the Data Controller, whereas “third party” cookies are installed by third parties.
For any question concerning the protection of your Personal Data, you may contact our Group DPO by writing to: PrivacyDPO@lavazza.com
3. TECHNICAL, ANALYTICS, AND FUNCTIONAL COOKIES

The cookies described in this section are sent directly from this website and can be either first-party or third-party. These cookies are installed for the purposes detailed for the various categories of cookies listed below:

Technical Cookies _ These cookies are installed in order to optimise and improve our website or to enhance its functions and performance. This type of cookies is used, for instance, to save users’ preferences for the use of cookies on the website. Technical cookies are not used for any other purpose and can be managed by Lavazza or by third parties.
These categories of cookies can be used without the prior and express consent of the user. These cookies are enabled automatically.

Analytics Cookies _ This category includes “ performance or analytics cookies”. These are cookies that collect information on the number of users that visit a website and on the most visited website’s pages/sections (for example, from what pages we receive reports of problems). These cookies provide information to the Controller on how its websites/apps perform and can be used with the consent of the user.

Functionality Cookies _ These cookies allow users to navigate on a website in accordance to selected criteria (e.g., language, text characters, type of browser) in order to improve the service offered and can be used with the consent of the user.
4. PROFILING COOKIES

Profiling cookies store information on users’ preferences during their navigation and are installed to create user profiles in order to provide targeted services or content, show content or offer commercial initiatives based on the sections in our websites that showed most relevant for users and their interests.
Profiling cookies can be used with the consent of the user. Consent is acquired through a banner, displayed on the user’s first visit by clicking on “Manage your preferences”.
5. TRACKING TECHNOLOGIES

Our Websites and Apps also use technologies that are similar to cookies, known as “tagging” technologies. These allow us to understand what content appears most interesting to our users and whether a particular offer may be of interest.

The information acquired through tagging technologies can be used, with the consent of the user, to show the products and commercial offers that are most relevant to their preferences. Consent is acquired through a banner, displayed on the user’s first visit, by clicking on “Manage your preferences”.
6. THIRD-PARTY COOKIES AND SOCIAL MEDIA BUTTONS
Third-party cookies are installed by third-party website, outside the Website where a user is navigating, in order to provide targeted services or content.

This website also uses social media button s – meaning digital buttons (or icons) we use to provide a direct connection to our social media pages (e.g., Facebook, YouTube, Instagram, Twitter) or for user authentication or registration (e.g., Google, Amazon, Facebook) which can install third-party cookies, that is cookies from the social media networks they refer to.

The social media icons/buttons on our website can also provide us with information about the user’s browsing experience and can be used by Lavazza for targeting purposes for marketing on social media (for example, allowing users to be reached by Lavazza advertising on their social accounts).

Third-party cookies can only be used with the prior consent of the user which is obtained via the banner as detailed above. Users can revoke their consent at any time by disabling cookies, following the steps detailed in paragraph “ How to Manage Cookies ” below.
7. COOKIE DURATIONS
Cookies may be:

· Temporary or session cookies: they are used to store temporary information and to connect actions performed during a specific session and are removed from the user’s computer once the browser is closed.

· Permanent or persistent cookies: they are used to store information such as name and access password so that users do not need to enter this information every time they visit a particular website. These cookies are permanently stored in the users’ computers after they close their browser.

Duration depends on the expiry set at the time of cookie installation. To know the duration of each single cookie, you can refer to our cookie manager section which also reports the name, category, and purposes of each cookie.
8. HOW TO MANAGE COOKIES
Users may set their cookie preferences

a. through our Website, in the cookie manager section – which allows users to select the type of cookies (including cookies from third-party partners) that can be installed, go through the list of cookies and similar technologies used on the Website or remove them

b. from their browser and prevent, for example, non-partner third parties from installing cookies. In this case, the procedures to manage permissions for cookie installation and remove cookies vary according to the browser used. You can find more information on how to manage cookies on your browser at: Google Chrome , Mozilla Firefox , Apple Safari and Microsoft Edge .
In case of services provided by (non-partner) third parties, users can also exercise their right to object to tracking using the information provided in the Privacy Policies of said third parties.
9. RIGHTS OF DATA SUBJECTS AND HOW TO EXERCISE DATA SUBJECTS’ RIGHTS

Data Subjects can exercise the rights afforded under the applicable privacy regulations, as per Articles 15-22 of the GDPR. For any information / reqyuest concerning the processing of your personal data and to exercise any of the rights under Articles 15-22 of the GDPR, you can contact our Group DPO at PrivacyDPO@lavazza.com

This Cookie Policy may be amended from time to time. This may be the case, for instance, when it is required to meet new sector regulations, to update or provide new services, or when new technologies are implemented. Users are therefore invited to read this Cookie Policy frequently to check on any updates or changes.
CALLING ALL UK BARISTAS

The Lavazza Barista Challenge UK is back and bigger than ever. Submit your entry for the chance to represent the UK on a global stage and win incredible prizes, including a trip to the home of Lavazza in Turin, Italy.
What is the Lavazza Barista Challenge?
This Year's Challenge
Finalists will be challenged to:
Craft their coffee story, bringing their interpretation of the Italian coffee ritual to life
Create a hot or cold signature coffee recipe using Lavazza Tales of Italy
Curate a memorable serving experience to complement their creation
Want to be part of the challenge?
Submit your entry by sending us a short video introducing yourself and showing us what you can do.
Your video should be 1–2 minutes long and include:
Make your favourite coffee and show us how you prepare it.
Tell us about your coffee journey so far, whether you’re just starting out or have been behind the bar for years.
Let your personality come through. We want to get to know the person behind the coffee.

There’s no need for a complicated recipe or polished production. Keep it simple and be yourself. We’re looking for baristas who are confident making great coffee, passionate about what they do and ready to take on the challenge.
Ready to enter? Click the link below, attach your video and submit your entry by November 10th.
SUBMIT YOUR ENTRY

description: Welcome to Barista Skills – Foundation, your introduction to the essential principles of great coffee. Coffee Courses
description: Discover our range of in-person Lavazza Training courses, designed to build practical skills rooted in Italian coffee tradition. From essential barista foundations to intermediate espresso techniques, latte art mastery and professional tasting sessions, each course offers hands-on learning guided by Lavazza’s proven methodology. These programmes provide a clear path to developing confidence, speed and consistency behind the bar.

title: SCA Certified Courses
description: Discover our full range of SCA Certified Training, from foundational barista and brewing skills to advanced professional courses. Each programme offers structured, internationally recognised learning designed to strengthen your technical ability and understanding of coffee.

title: Lavazza Barista Skills Foundation
summary: This engaging one-day course is tailored to introduce the essential skills for working with Lavazza coffee and equipment. Participants will learn how to operate an espresso machine, correctly set a grinder for optimal Lavazza extraction, and master the basics of milk steaming and pouring for popular beverages. A strong emphasis is placed on efficiency, cleanliness, and the Lavazza quality standards to ensure a consistent customer experience.
outcomes: This comprehensive one-day course covers the foundational knowledge and practical skills needed to set up a grinder, understand basic coffee quality, master essential milk techniques, and create classic espresso beverages. You will learn about the journey of coffee from seed to cup, workplace health and safety protocols, and the crucial practice of daily equipment maintenance. It’s the essential starting point for any aspiring SCA Barista.
keyTopics: 1. Introduction to Lavazza espresso excellence
2. Grinder calibration and dosing principles
3. Basic milk preparation and drink building

title: Lavazza Barista Skills Intermediate
summary: Over two days, this course builds technical proficiency and deepens the understanding of how to achieve perfect Lavazza beverages consistently. You will focus on refining extraction techniques through sensory analysis, improving efficiency in a high-volume setting, and troubleshooting common issues with the espresso equipment. The course also includes an in-depth review of the Lavazza flavour profile and how to maintain it under pressure.
outcomes: This comprehensive one-day course covers the foundational knowledge and practical skills needed to set up a grinder, understand basic coffee quality, master essential milk techniques, and create classic espresso beverages. You will learn about the journey of coffee from seed to cup, workplace health and safety protocols, and the crucial practice of daily equipment maintenance. It’s the essential starting point for any aspiring SCA Barista.
keyTopics: 1. Advanced Lavazza sensory analysis
2. Efficiency and workflow management
3. Quality control and recipe refinement

title: Lavazza Latte Art Milk Steaming
summary: This highly practical 90-minute workshop is essential for anyone aiming to pour excellent latte art. The entire focus is on milk preparation: understanding different types of milk (dairy and alternatives), optimising jug technique, and achieving the consistently silky microfoam required to create definition and contrast in your designs. Learn to steam milk efficiently with zero waste, perfect for a busy environment.
outcomes: This comprehensive one-day course covers the foundational knowledge and practical skills needed to set up a grinder, understand basic coffee quality, master essential milk techniques, and create classic espresso beverages. You will learn about the journey of coffee from seed to cup, workplace health and safety protocols, and the crucial practice of daily equipment maintenance. It’s the essential starting point for any aspiring SCA Barista.
keyTopics: 1. The science of microfoam and aeration
2. Perfect temperature and texture control
3. Milk pitcher technique and hygiene

title: Lavazza Latte Art Pouring
summary: Following the milk steaming session, this 90-minute workshop focuses purely on the pouring mechanics of latte art. Participants will learn the core techniques of positioning, setting the ‘canvas’, and manipulating the flow of milk to create a Heart and an introductory Rosetta or Tulip pattern. This is a hands-on session designed to rapidly develop muscle memory and consistency for beautiful, appealing beverages.
outcomes: This comprehensive one-day course covers the foundational knowledge and practical skills needed to set up a grinder, understand basic coffee quality, master essential milk techniques, and create classic espresso beverages. You will learn about the journey of coffee from seed to cup, workplace health and safety protocols, and the crucial practice of daily equipment maintenance. It’s the essential starting point for any aspiring SCA Barista.
keyTopics: 1. The three phases of latte art pouring
2. Mastering the classic Heart pattern
3. Introduction to advanced pour patterns (Rosetta/Tulip)

title: SCA Barista Foundation
summary: This comprehensive one-day course covers the foundational knowledge and practical skills needed to set up a grinder, understand basic coffee quality, master essential milk techniques, and create classic espresso beverages. You will learn about the journey of coffee from seed to cup, workplace health and safety protocols, and the crucial practice of daily equipment maintenance. It’s the essential starting point for any aspiring SCA Barista.
outcomes: This comprehensive one-day course covers the foundational knowledge and practical skills needed to set up a grinder, understand basic coffee quality, master essential milk techniques, and create classic espresso beverages. You will learn about the journey of coffee from seed to cup, workplace health and safety protocols, and the crucial practice of daily equipment maintenance. It’s the essential starting point for any aspiring SCA Barista.
keyTopics: 1. Espresso machine operation and preparation
2. Understanding the coffee journey and provenance
3. Basic milk texturing and drink presentation

title: SCA Barista Intermediate
summary: Over two detailed days, participants will delve deeper into the science of espresso extraction, analysing and measuring the impact of variables like grind size, brew ratio, and water chemistry on the flavour. You will refine your advanced milk texturing and pouring techniques, including introductory latte art, and learn to manage workflow for speed and consistency. The course covers comprehensive equipment maintenance and calibration, preparing you for a senior barista role.
outcomes: This comprehensive one-day course covers the foundational knowledge and practical skills needed to set up a grinder, understand basic coffee quality, master essential milk techniques, and create classic espresso beverages. You will learn about the journey of coffee from seed to cup, workplace health and safety protocols, and the crucial practice of daily equipment maintenance. It’s the essential starting point for any aspiring SCA Barista.
keyTopics: 1. Advanced espresso extraction analysis and measurement
2. Workflow management and service efficiency
3. SCA sensory skills and flavour evaluation

title: SCA Barista Professional
summary: A rigorous three-day programme for experienced baristas ready to master the craft and take on a leadership role. This course demands a high level of technical and sensory skill, focusing on the management of quality and consistency across multiple scenarios. Topics include advanced water chemistry, detailed grinder calibration for optimum flavour, comprehensive extraction troubleshooting, and designing recipes for specific sensory targets. You will emerge as an SCA-accredited coffee expert, capable of managing and mentoring others.
outcomes: This comprehensive one-day course covers the foundational knowledge and practical skills needed to set up a grinder, understand basic coffee quality, master essential milk techniques, and create classic espresso beverages. You will learn about the journey of coffee from seed to cup, workplace health and safety protocols, and the crucial practice of daily equipment maintenance. It’s the essential starting point for any aspiring SCA Barista.
keyTopics: 1. Applied water chemistry and flavour impact
2. Advanced problem-solving and quality management
3. Mastering consistency and developing coffee recipes

title: SCA Brewing Foundation
summary: This essential one-day course provides a foundational understanding of the various methods for brewing coffee, from automatic batch brewers to manual pour-over devices. You will learn how brewing variables—such as grind size, water temperature, and brew ratio—affect the final cup. The course introduces the importance of coffee species (Arabica vs. Robusta) and processing methods on flavour, providing the knowledge to begin consistently brewing high-quality filter coffee.
outcomes: This comprehensive one-day course covers the foundational knowledge and practical skills needed to set up a grinder, understand basic coffee quality, master essential milk techniques, and create classic espresso beverages. You will learn about the journey of coffee from seed to cup, workplace health and safety protocols, and the crucial practice of daily equipment maintenance. It’s the essential starting point for any aspiring SCA Barista.
keyTopics: 1. Understanding brewing variables and the 7 Essential Elements
2. Evaluating different brewing methods and equipment
3. Water quality and its impact on taste

title: SCA Brewing Intermediate
summary: Over two days, this intermediate course takes a deep dive into the mathematics and science of brewing. Participants will learn to precisely measure and control the primary brewing variables—time, temperature, turbulence, and ratio—to achieve specific sensory targets using devices like refractometers. You will gain a much deeper understanding of grind science, learn how to chart and analyse extraction using the SCA Coffee Brewing Control Chart, and troubleshoot common issues for achieving optimum extraction yield.
outcomes: This comprehensive one-day course covers the foundational knowledge and practical skills needed to set up a grinder, understand basic coffee quality, master essential milk techniques, and create classic espresso beverages. You will learn about the journey of coffee from seed to cup, workplace health and safety protocols, and the crucial practice of daily equipment maintenance. It’s the essential starting point for any aspiring SCA Barista.
keyTopics: 1. Extraction measurement and the SCA Brewing Control Chart
2. Advanced grind science and particle analysis
3. Mastery of manual brewing devices and methods

title: SCA Brewing Professional
summary: A comprehensive three-day course for those who want to achieve the highest level of expertise in brewing. The Professional module focuses on advanced problem-solving, detailed equipment analysis, and quality assurance management. You will learn to conduct in-depth analysis of brew quality, manage multiple brewing systems in a commercial setting, and apply complex scientific theory to everyday operational decisions. This is the certification for senior trainers, quality control staff, and green coffee buyers.
outcomes: This comprehensive one-day course covers the foundational knowledge and practical skills needed to set up a grinder, understand basic coffee quality, master essential milk techniques, and create classic espresso beverages. You will learn about the journey of coffee from seed to cup, workplace health and safety protocols, and the crucial practice of daily equipment maintenance. It’s the essential starting point for any aspiring SCA Barista.
keyTopics: 1. Advanced scientific brew analysis and diagnostics
2. Equipment calibration, maintenance, and diagnostics
3. Quality management and implementing best brewing practices

title: SCA Introduction to Coffee
summary: The SCA Introduction to Coffee course provides a broad overview of coffee, following its journey from farm to cup. Designed as the starting point for coffee education, it introduces the essential concepts behind how coffee is grown, processed, roasted, brewed and evaluated. Participants will explore the history of coffee and learn how origin, processing methods and roasting decisions influence flavour. The course also introduces professional sensory skills through cupping, helping learners identify and describe aroma and taste. Practical brewing sessions focus on filter coffee using the Hario V60, covering brew ratios, extraction principles and the importance of water chemistry. Ideal for coffee enthusiasts and those considering a career in the industry, this course offers valuable insight into the wider world of coffee and the many professional pathways it can lead to.
outcomes: By the end of this course, participants will have a clear understanding of how coffee moves from farm to cup and how each stage impacts quality, flavour and final presentation.
keyTopics: 1. Coffee origins, history and the farm-to-cup journey
2. Processing, roasting and their impact on flavour
3. Sensory skills, cupping and filter brewing fundamentals
